name: TAXONOMY_DISCOVERY
findings: IPP taxonomy version uniform: 2019-01-01 (Circular 3/2018) across the corpus.
IPP model families: SAN/BBVA = ipp_en (entidades/credit model), IBE = ipp_ge (general model). Structural difference discoverable from namespace/schemaRef, not issuer name.
H1 vs H2 falsified: same taxonomy for both; H2 small size is fewer facts, not a different taxonomy (SAN H2-2025 uses ipp_en/2019-01-01).
ESEF: the R7 artefacts (now ESEF_COVER) are the cover page (no ix:/schemaRef); the inline-XBRL report and ZIP/Xbri package are separate components.

ESEF IXBRL_CONSOLIDATED schemaRef (OBSERVED for all 6 filings, incl. FY2024): SAN FY2025=http://www.santander.com/20251231/5493006QMFDDMYWIAM13-2025-12-31.xsd / FY2024=http://www.santanderbank.com/20241231/5493006QMFDDMYWIAM13-2024-12-31.xsd; BBVA FY2025=http://www.bbva.es/20251231/K8MS7FD7N5Z2WQ51AZ71-2025-12-31.xsd / FY2024=http://www.bbva.es/20241231/K8MS7FD7N5Z2WQ51AZ71-2024-12-31.xsd; IBE FY2025=http://www.iberdrola.com/20251231/5QK37QC7NWOJ8D7WVQ45-2025-12-31.xsd / FY2024=http://www.iberdrola.com/20241231/5QK37QC7NWOJ8D7WVQ45-2024-12-31.xsd.
NOTABLE: SAN's extension taxonomy domain changed between years (santanderbank.com FY2024 -> santander.com FY2025).

ESEF iXBRL requires the issuer extension taxonomy + the ESMA ESEF base taxonomy package; the cover XHTML alone is insufficient for offline reconstruction -> ZIP/Xbri package (extension taxonomy) is a required dependency for R10.
Content sniffing used, never the file extension; raw files are .zip-named but IPP=XML, ESEF=XHTML, ESEF package=real ZIP.
limitations: Extension taxonomy URLs are on issuer domains (external); must be fetched/pinned in R10 for offline determinism.
